name: berean
description: Digest-pinned agent releases with byte-exact citations, block-bound reads and evaluated refusals.

interface.shortDescription: Digest-pinned agent releases with byte-exact citations, block-bound reads and evaluated refusals.
interface.longDescription: Berean checks protocol-agent releases without rerunning the model. A release pins its corpus by digest, proves citations against exact bytes, binds each live value to a chain and block, separates source classes, records refusals, and preserves the evaluation, promotion, or rollback decision. The checked-in reference still uses a demonstration corpus and preserved Aave v4 reads; no live Wildcat reference release or Ariadne binding exists yet.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $berean to verify this release's citations, chain readings and promotion record against its pinned corpus.
